Name: 4-4-2 Diamond
Description: A fairly aggressive formation centered around breaking through the other's team center. Defence will need to coordinate well with midfield.

Name: 4-4-2 Box
Description: A balanced formation with a strong center. Allows for a smooth transition between offence and defence.

Name: 3-5-2 Freedom
Description: A highly strategic formation whose success depends on the playmaker. Distinctive for its changeable playstyle.

Name: 4-3-3 Triangle
Description: An offensive formation that enables the team to take the initiative. Well suited to fast plays down the sides of the pitch.

Name: 4-3-3 Delta
Description: A piercing formation with great potential for various offensive strategies. Allows the forwards to easily and aggressively pressure the opponent.

Name: 4-5-1 Balanced
Description: A stable formation that renders both offence and defence airtight. Makes it easy to keep possession by passing the ball.

Name: 3-6-1 Hexa
Description: A flexible formation that allows for various strategies. The heavy midfield presence enables all manner of offence.

Name: 5-4-1 Double Volante
Description: A sturdy formation with solid central defence. A core tenet is that attacks can be launched from both sides.
